verdict.rationale: Anrok files and pays returns for sellers (anrok-docs-28) and documents an API endpoint to fetch filings (anrok-docs-12). Transactions are associated with tax returns (anrok-docs-6, anrok-docs-35), and filings can be queried through AI Atlas (anrok-docs-15). This shows filing data is exposed, but none of the specific views the story asks for are documented. Missing for 10: a calendar of upcoming returns, per-filing status tracking, amounts remitted per filing, downloadable filing confirmations, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
